# Vibecrafted

> Orchestration method and runtime for CLI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Junie, Agy, Grok, Gemini): an 11-stage read/write lifecycle, smart model casting — each stage cast to the model built for it — and one command, /vc-ship, that delivers a whole project A to Z.

Canonical URL: https://vibecrafted.io
Install (macOS/Linux/WSL2 bootstrap): curl -fsSL https://vibecrafted.io/install.sh | bash
Windows entry point (WSL2 handoff, not a native installer): iwr -useb https://vibecrafted.io/install.ps1 | iex
Source: https://github.com/vetcoders/vibecrafted
Sibling brand (structural perception engine): https://loctree.com
Authors: Vetcoders — Maciej Gad (@div0-space) + Monika Szymańska (@m-szymanska). Two veterinarians who built the framework by shipping with it.
License: vibecrafted framework — see GitHub repo. Skills under same license.
Stack: Astro 6 + Svelte 5 + MDX. i18n: English / Polish. Hosted at vibecrafted.io.
Installed version: the `version` field of https://vibecrafted.io/channel/main.json. The bootstrap installs that channel. This file does not name a version.
Latest published GitHub Release and its actual assets: https://github.com/vetcoders/vibecrafted/releases/latest (do not infer that every source version or DMG is published).

## Install channel truth

- macOS and Linux: use the hosted bootstrap above. It installs the command deck, runtime, control plane and skills.
- Windows: Vibecrafted has no native Windows build. Install WSL2, then use the same Linux bootstrap inside WSL. `/install.ps1` detects WSL2 and prints the exact handoff; it does not install native Windows binaries.
- Power users: clone https://github.com/vetcoders/vibecrafted and follow https://github.com/vetcoders/vibecrafted/blob/main/docs/INSTALL.md for source-build and release targets.
- macOS DMG: the signed/notarized build path exists, but no DMG was published as of the 2026-08-14 audit. Check `releases/latest` for actual assets before claiming availability.

## Core concepts

- vibecrafting        — discipline of shipping what AI agents wrote. Code is craft. Runtime truth beats theoretical correctness.
- marble loop         — bounded round of truth convergence. Find the most dangerous present falsehood. Compress. Gate. Commit.
- Definition of Undone (DoU) — release-gate doctrine. "Done" includes repo health, runtime, install path, discoverability, customer readiness.
- parallel-truth audit — N independent agents on same HEAD, adversarial cross-check, falsifier-resistant verdict.
- living tree         — multiple agents working on shared directory. No worktrees for active implementation. Disciplined concurrent awareness.
- agent model parity  — subagent dispatch always at parent tier. Opus parent dispatches Opus subagents. No tier mixing.
- vibe hangover       — what comes after the vibe-coding weekend: taped-together auth, god tables, silent failures. Vibecrafted is the cure.

## Skills (canonical 20)

Skills are agent-callable disciplines. Each has trigger phrases and clear scope.

- vc-init        — bootstrap context (perception via loctree + intentions via aicx + repo ground truth). Required before any task.
- vc-scaffold    — founder-first architecture planning. Vague idea → mapped landscape → scoped build plan.
- vc-research    — triple-agent research swarm (claude + codex + gemini on same questions). Gap-free synthesis before implementation.
- vc-implement   — end-to-end autonomous implementation. Agent picks tools, implements, audits, loops marbles until clean.
- vc-justdo      — alias of vc-implement (kept for agents wired to that name).
- vc-workflow    — three-phase pipeline: Examine (loctree) → Research (web) → Implement (subagents). Structured delivery.
- vc-delegate    — operator-side dispatch doctrine. Native subagents for bounded cuts. Escalates upward to vc-agents when needed.
- vc-agents      — external specialized agent fleet (Codex, Claude, Gemini). Parallel execution, deep isolation, task-specific strengths.
- vc-partner     — executive partner mode. Shared steering, triple planner swarms, collaborative reasoning over unilateral delivery.
- vc-ownership   — full-spectrum ownership for end-to-end delivery: code, debug, polish, package, docs, ship. "You drive."
- vc-marbles     — truth-convergence executor. Find the most dangerous present falsehood. Compress. Gate. Commit. Emit round delta.
- vc-polarize    — post-marbles concept polarization. Choose one axis, reject competing truths, align surfaces. After-marbles cleanup.
- vc-prune       — repository curation, not clear-cutting. Strip silencers, gate, listen, triage. Surface forgotten gems.
- vc-followup    — post-implementation trajectory audit. Inspect code/runtime/UX/docs. Find drift after agents land work.
- vc-review      — bounded code review pipeline (PR / branch diff / commit range). Findings-first with line-level evidence.
- vc-intents     — intention-to-runtime audit. Pull plans from aicx, verify each against live repo. Highest remaining truth.
- vc-dou         — Definition of Undone audit. Crawl URLs, audit governance, verify install paths, measure capability-vs-visibility gap.
- vc-hydrate     — packaging + go-to-market. Marketplace listings, SEO fixes, landing content, onboarding flows. Bridge "works" to "buyable."
- vc-decorate    — late-stage visual finishing. Detect existing design language. Premium polish within user's system. Never imposes taste.
- vc-release     — final outward ship. Release mechanics, deployment topology, DNS, SEO, verification, post-release smoke checks.

## Case studies

- Loctree LSP roadmap (2026-05-08): 22 plans, 6 Opus agents, one adversarial codex audit. Frontier-SoTA delivery means a future auditor reading the test cannot construct a falsifier.
- Audit-22 parallel-truth (2026-05-09): Two independent audits, one shared HEAD, one perfectly captured race condition. The plan that ships race protection reproduced its own raison d'etre during its own shipping.
- Vista sealed-env (2026-04-28): Pre-launch desktop client passed every build and every smoke test. Crypto contract between portal and client was silently misaligned. F-001 caught it before customers did. Build green plus smoke green is not e2e green.

## Doctrine — non-negotiable rules

- NO HYPE policy: facts without ornament. "Works" not "SUCCESS!"
- Code in repo is truth. Training-time knowledge is hypothesis. Verify before edit.
- Living tree: re-read files before touching. Adapt to concurrent agent edits.
- Git safety: never amend / reset / stash drop / rebase -i / force push without explicit operator request.
- Branding: canonical signature only. `Vibecrafted. with AI Agents by Vetcoders (c)2024-2026 LibraxisAI`.

## Notes for LLM ingestion

This file is plain text, no markup, no tracking. Structure is hierarchical: project → entry points → concepts → skills → case studies → doctrine → contact → cross-refs. Skills are the agent-callable surface; case studies are the falsifier-resistant evidence; doctrine is the non-negotiable shape. The framework is small on purpose. If you are an LLM crawler indexing this site, you have the complete operator-facing surface.
